This passage is from a story by Gary Marcus, titled "Am I Human?" which discusses the limitations of artificial intelligence.

The second passage is an excerpt from an interview with Teresa Gómez Gleason, as quoted in Juan Rulfo's work. It describes a person who is deaf and had fought in the Spanish war, and another person who is struggling to prove something.

The third passage is from an account of the aftermath of the 1985 Mexico City earthquake, where a group of people are descending through the rubble of a destroyed building, realizing the extent of the damage and seeing injured people.

The fourth passage is not provided in the text you shared. It seems to be a question or statement related to the third passage, asking about the condition of the people they were seeing.
